q: What are the three search modes FILMCRAFT_ASSIST_SEARCH accepts?
a: `words` (the default: guide sections are ranked by the words they share with your question, like Ask the coach), `meaning` (an embedding model on this computer ranks them by meaning) and `mixed` (the word ranking's best three sections stay first and the meaning ranking fills the rest). Set it when you start Revolution, for example `FILMCRAFT_ASSIST_SEARCH=mixed`. There is no setting for it yet; it is being measured.

q: Does the Assistant's meaning search send my questions anywhere?
a: No. The embedding model runs on this computer (BAAI bge-small-en-v1.5, MIT licence, about 130 MB, in the models folder under `embed/bge-small-en-v1.5`). It only ranks Revolution's own guide sections against your question.

q: I described my problem in my own words and the Assistant pulled up the wrong guide pages. Can that be improved?
a: By default the Assistant finds guide sections by shared words, so unusual wording can miss. You can try the optional search by meaning: start Revolution with `FILMCRAFT_ASSIST_SEARCH=mixed`, which keeps the word ranking's best three sections and lets an embedding model on this computer (bge-small-en-v1.5) fill the rest by meaning. It is still being measured, so it isn't the default yet.

q: Should I use Meaning or Mixed for the Assistant's search?
a: Mixed is the safer choice to try: the word ranking's best three sections stay first, so questions that already find their answer by exact words keep it, and meaning only adds sections after them. Meaning on its own ranks everything by meaning, which can help with very different wordings but can push out an exact match. Both are being measured; the guide makes one the default only if the Assistant's measured answers improve with no lookups lost. Words (the default) needs no model at all.

q: Every time I start Revolution with meaning search, will the Assistant take minutes before it answers?
a: No, only the first time. The first answer prepares every guide section once, which takes minutes; later starts reuse that work, so answers come at the usual speed.

q: When will search by meaning become the Assistant's normal behaviour?
a: Only if it is shown to help: it becomes the default when the Assistant's measured answers improve with no lookups lost compared with the word ranking. Until then the default stays words, and you can try it yourself with `FILMCRAFT_ASSIST_SEARCH=mixed` (or `meaning`) when starting Revolution.
